item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Creamy tomato soup on soffritto with cannellini beans and roasted chickpeas, topped with parsley and chives. Served with whipped ricotta and toasted sourdough. Also available gluten free. (1+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Harissa-roasted carrots served with a rye and spelt grain salad tossed with quinoa and vegetables, topped with toasted sunflower seeds and chickpeas tossed with parsley. Served with bean purée and salted yoghurt. Also available gluten free with rice. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Aloo pakora, Nepalese potato pakora, served with spiced yellow rice and mint yoghurt. (6+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Tom yum, a delicious, warming Thai soup with tofu, mushrooms, sweetcorn and greens. Wonderful aromas of lemongrass and galangal. (7+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Aloo tikki burger, Indian-inspired burger with aloo tikki (spiced potato patties with vegetables, peas and lentils), lettuce, fresh greens, sriracha mayonnaise and apple and onion chutney. Served with watermelon chaat (Indian watermelon salad, similar to a Greek watermelon salad without cheese). Also available gluten free and vegan. (1+2+6+11+15)
